verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe v0 as an AI agent that turns natural-language prompts into full-stack apps (scaffolding, backend connections, one-click deploy), and an independent HN account confirms a founder built a working, feature-rich MVP (auth, roles, export) in 48 hours using v0. Missing for 10: broader independent case studies beyond one HN post, and evidence addressing complexity/scale limits beyond simple MVPs.
